identity.title: CVE-2026-105221
identity.description: The gist RubyGem before 6.1.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to intercept HTTPS traffic because http_connection in lib/gist.rb sets VERIFY_NONE. Attackers can present any certificate to read or modify GitHub API traffic, stealing OAuth tokens and login credentials to read and modify the victim's gists.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: RubyGem library with improper TLS validation enabling OAuth token and credential theft, plausible enterprise/CI-CD footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105222
identity.description: The alexpechkarev/google-maps Laravel package through 12.16 disables TLS certificate verification by default because the bundled config sets ssl_verify_peer to FALSE, which is passed to CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER. On-path attackers can present any certificate to intercept Google Maps web-service requests, steal the API key from the query string, and tamper with responses.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Laravel package disabling TLS verification by default, exposing API keys in plausible enterprise web deployments.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105219
identity.description: Mammoth.js 1.3.0 before 1.12.3 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in the style map tokeniser in lib/styles/parser/tokeniser.js due to overlapping regex alternatives. Attackers can supply a crafted .docx with an unterminated quoted string of repeated backslash escapes in mammoth/style-map to block the Node.js event loop.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Widely deployed JavaScript document parsing library with ReDoS impacting Node.js event loop, plausible enterprise web footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105218
identity.description: gopay before 1.5.119 disables TLS certificate verification in defaultClient() in pkg/xhttp/client.go, allowing man-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate payment provider APIs. Attackers can present any certificate to read merchant credentials, signatures and transaction data, and modify payment, refund and order query responses.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Go payment client library disabling TLS verification, exposing merchant credentials and transaction data in financial services context.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105216
identity.description: go-micro before 6.0.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows network attackers to impersonate services because the shared TLS helper sets InsecureSkipVerify to true by default. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to intercept or modify gRPC transport, HTTP and RabbitMQ broker, and Consul or etcd registry traffic, including authentication tokens and credentials.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Microservices framework disabling TLS verification, exposing authentication tokens and credentials across gRPC, RabbitMQ, and service registries.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105158
identity.description: A vulnerability was detected in RainyGao DocSys up to 2.02.85. The impacted element is the function BaseController.createDBForMysql of the file BaseController.java of the component Database Management. The manipulation of the argument url results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
cwe_names.CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

_relevance.reason: Remote SQL injection in document management system with public exploit, plausible enterprise footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105215
identity.description: ZITADEL before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 UI because the 'external account not found' registration endpoint trusts client-supplied external identity fields without a completed IdP callback. Unauthenticated attackers can submit forged IDPConfigID and ExternalUserID values to pre-create an account bound to a victim's external IdP identity, which the victim's later genuine external login then signs into.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated authentication bypass in ZITADEL IdP allowing account takeover via forged external identity fields.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105212
identity.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 and Login V2 UIs that accepts passkey or other authenticator enrollment on identify-only login sessions, before any primary factor is verified. Unauthenticated attackers knowing only a victim's login name can register an attacker-controlled authenticator and log in as that user, bypassing existing passwords and MFA.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated authentication bypass in ZITADEL IdP allowing MFA bypass and account takeover via premature authenticator enrollment.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105213
identity.description: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.17.1 does not check an organization's inactive state during Login V2 authentication, verifying only the individual user's status. Users of a deactivated organization who hold valid credentials, an existing session, or a refresh token can still sign in, create sessions, and obtain or refresh tokens.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Session and token refresh bypass in ZITADEL IdP allowing deactivated organization users to maintain access.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105211
identity.description: ZITADEL before 4.17.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in Login V2 that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over accounts by obtaining OTP codes via the returnCode delivery type. Attackers knowing a login name of a victim with OTP-Email and OTP-SMS enrolled can read both codes from server-action responses to gain MFA-authenticated sessions, including administrator takeover.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated authentication bypass in ZITADEL IdP leaking OTP codes to enable MFA bypass and administrator account takeover.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105209
identity.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability: when issuing passkey or passwordless enrollment codes, it checks only the organization in the x-zitadel-orgid header, not the target user's organization. Attackers with user-write permission in one organization can obtain an enrollment code for a user in another organization on the same instance and register their own authenticator to take over that account.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Cross-tenant authorization bypass in ZITADEL IdP allowing authenticator enrollment and account takeover across organizations.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105210
identity.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.1 contains a missing authentication flaw in the hosted Login V1 UI, whose second-factor enrollment and initialization handlers act on an identify-only session before any primary factor is verified. Attackers knowing only a victim's login name can enroll attacker-controlled TOTP, OTP-SMS, OTP-Email, or U2F factors, overwrite the verified phone number, and enumerate users through discrepant errors.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Missing authentication in ZITADEL IdP allowing unauthenticated MFA enrollment and account takeover on identify-only sessions.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105207
identity.description: ZITADEL 3.0.0 through 3.4.15 and 4.0.0 before 4.17.3 creates links between user accounts and external identity providers without verifying a primary factor or the caller's permission, including on identify-only Login V2 sessions and via the User Service V2 AddIDPLink endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker knowing a victim's login name can bind their own external IdP identity to the victim's account and then sign in as the victim.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated authentication bypass in ZITADEL IdP allowing external IdP identity binding and victim account takeover.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105208
identity.description: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.17.3 and 3.x through 3.4.15 protects IdP intent tokens with unauthenticated, malleable encryption, allowing authenticated users to tamper with their own token so it is accepted for another user's external login intent. An attacker who predicts a victim's in-flight intent identifier and wins a timing race can call /v2/idp_intents or /v2/sessions to steal the victim's IdP tokens or hijack their session.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-649: Reliance on Obfuscation or Encryption of Security-Relevant Inputs without Integrity Checking

_relevance.reason: Core IdP software (ZITADEL) with session hijacking and token tampering vulnerability affecting authentication and identity management.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105135
identity.description: A vulnerability has been found in InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0. This issue affects the function ExecutionAction.run of the file mindsearch/agent/graph.py of the component Planner Agent. The manipulation of the argument inputs leads to code injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
cwe_names.CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

_relevance.reason: Remote code injection in open-source AI agent framework with public exploit and CVSS 10.0, meeting credible exploit and plausible enterprise footprint criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105134
identity.description: A flaw has been found in Ahsay AhsayCBS up to 10.3.2. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do of the component Replication Receiver. Executing a manipulation of the argument random can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 10.3.4 is able to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-77: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
cwe_names.CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

_relevance.reason: Remote OS command injection in enterprise backup software with public exploit and CVSS 10.0, meeting credible exploit and enterprise footprint criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-105133
identity.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ahsay AhsayCBS up to 10.3.2. This affects the function checkSysPwd of the file com/ahsay/obs/api/ApiStructsAction.java of the component API. Performing a manipulation of the argument random results in improper authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 10.3.4 is able to mitigate this issue. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Improper authentication in enterprise backup API with public exploit, matching identity/access weakness and enterprise footprint criteria.
